text: 【事关延长交易时段！香港证监会最新发声！】10月9日，香港证监会行政总裁梁凤仪在亚洲证券业与金融市场协会亚太资本市场流动性前瞻论坛上发布主题演说。她提到，香港市场未来将在提升资本效率、改革市场微观结构，以及构建流动性生态圈这三大领域持续发力。值得关注的是，梁凤仪透露，香港正在研究延长证券交易时段，并将率先在衍生产品市场推行，港交所也将于第四季度就延长现货市场交易时段发表讨论文件。
text_en: [Tied to extending trading hours! Hong Kong SFC's latest statement!] On October 9, Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission Chief Executive Officer Julia Leung delivered a keynote speech at the ASIFMA Asia-Pacific Capital Markets Liquidity Outlook Forum. She mentioned that the Hong Kong market will continue to focus on three major areas in the future: improving capital efficiency, reforming market microstructure, and building a liquidity ecosystem. Notably, Julia Leung revealed that Hong Kong is studying extending securities trading hours and will first implement it in the derivatives market, while HKEX will also publish a discussion paper in the fourth quarter on extending trading hours in the cash market.
